title: LCARS Events Catalogue v1
description: Structural schema for apps/fleet_event_router/priv/events.yaml (parsed YAML map). The runtime loader (Fleet.EventRouter.Catalog.load!/0) does NOT validate against this schema — it only populates authorized_event_types. This schema is exercised by events_schema_test.exs (ex_json_schema) as a build-time structural gate on the canon. Structural only: handler module *existence*, producer/consumer wiring, and asymmetries are out of scope here.

events.description: Map event_type -> [handler_module, ...]. Fan-out N handlers via Phoenix.PubSub.
